_help: Protected town zones (scripts/TownZones.cs, F-18). Inside a zone nobody digs, places or blasts blocks (spells, monster blasts, fire, frost and melt included) unless Admin.IsAdmin. Each town is a circle on the XZ plane: either a fixed x/z (Oakhaven) or a land place ('land' + 'place' ids from lands.json, centre = that place), radius in metres. The host/server also rejects block edits inside a zone (NetBlocks.cs). 'message' uses {town}. Edit radius here only.
message: This is {town}: building and digging are not allowed in town.
